findings.claim: The change touches a file far over the acceptance criterion's 500-line limit.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria execution note says "touched files remain at most 500 lines"; the diff modifies `Cargo.lock` at hunks beginning `@@ -3105`, `@@ -3238`, `@@ -8603`, and `@@ -8861`, proving the touched file exceeds 500 lines.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove `Cargo.lock` from this change by regenerating dependency updates without touching it only if possible, or update the acceptance criterion itself to explicitly exempt generated lockfiles rather than relying on a changed project rule.

findings.claim: Canonical decoding errors include raw source column values in their Display output, creating a sensitive-data logging risk when CDC errors are surfaced.
findings.evidence: `CanonicalError::Invalid` stores `value: String` and formats it as `#[error("column '{column}' contains invalid {kind}: {value}")]`; constraint S3 says "No sensitive logging" and specifically prohibits logging relation tuples.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove raw source values from error messages, or redact/truncate with an explicit non-sensitive diagnostic token such as type/column only.

findings.claim: The committed artifact manifest embeds absolute developer-local filesystem paths, making the artifact non-portable and unnecessarily exposing local environment details.
findings.evidence: The manifest lists files such as `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/flint-realtime-fabric/crates/frf-postgres-cdc/src/canonical.rs` instead of repository-relative paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Store only repository-relative paths in committed manifests.
